items.text: The previous version of Unity we were using contained an exploitable breach for hackers to use the built app to be granted permissions. No evidence of it being used, but we encourage you to update the game to be sure.
As many of you requested it, online achievements now work in local duel mode. The servers can be a bit janky to say the least, so it should secure those achievements for you, completionists!
​Mostly fixes of bugs you reported!
Fixed double tap dash not working online

Fixed Discord invitation text in the online menu
Because of a few bugs, only temporary

Following the feedback from the community we made a final balancing update to adjust what was needed.
Reverted Jinmu's range to a more acceptable state
Added 1 frame of startup delay to every attack of Jinmu
Increased a bit the startup of Jinmu's pommel strike
Reverted Stamina Break to affect 2 stamina bars
Hey everyone, before bug fixes for the online mode and an upcoming tournament we wanted to update a bit of the game's balancing after the community's feedback and our feelings about the characters.
IZANAGI
Increased attack range a bit
Increased parry recovery speed
Made stomp anim faster
Increased a bit stomp range
Sped up a bit Perfect Parry anim: SUSANOO
Increased a bit invulnerability duration on dashes. i-frames also start earlier now
Sped up a bit kick anim startup
Sped up a bit attack animations: JINMU
Removed i-frames on his neutral attack
Reduced a bit light attack range: MASKED RONIN
Increased a bit pommel strike range: OTHER STUFF
Changed parry stamina recovery to be 3 bars instead of 2
Changed stamina break to be 1 bar instead of 2: Hopefully, these will make the game feel more balanced and all options worth it. Let us know your thoughts when playing this new version, thanks !
Fixed "Not even a scratch" achievement no triggering in game.
Fixed Pixel DLC detection for Steam
Removed a tip that was wrong
Tried a fix for the screen size and resolution for different screen configurations

items.text: Released online mode for one week for test purposes

Fixed! The game was not recognizing Chapter 5 save files because of some last-minute changes. The good news is that the save file is not deleted, unless you overwrote it by starting a new game you should be able to continue your playthrough normally.
Enforced 16:9 aspect ratio for wide screens
Set Akiko to not be here in Zen mode in Chapter 5
Adjusted firewall distance for Ryuujin checkpoint in Chapter 4
Changed the speed of the Firewall visuals

Updated credits to put some names that were missing from them
Fixed active frames of Masked Ronin
Added text indicator below the modes' names in the story menu to tell the player they will overwrite their current save file if they have one.: Thanks, everyone, for reporting bugs!
The Glitch DLC should now work.

-Sclash Team
